decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of two years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - 2. The external surface of the buiding hereby approved shall be painted to match, as closely as possible, the external surfaces of the existing nursery bnuilding.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of 3 years expiring on 17 November 2008 when the use shall cease and the portable building permitted shall be removed and the land restored  to its former condition.

Condition : 5 - 5. Before the temporary building hereby approved is occupied, a path that separates pedestrians access to the building from the car parking, shall be defined with timber baulks, or similar, and retained while the building is in use.
description: Installation of a temporary portable building for use as a nursery for 3 months - 2 year olds.
